title: Access problem codes
description: Stable RFC 9457 problem codes of the shared HTTP stack and the management API (OP-65, OP-149 m.12).

codes.title: Not Found
codes.description: No such resource, or one the caller may not see (TN-113).

codes.title: Internal Server Error
codes.description: A server failure; details stay in the logs.

codes.title: Service Unavailable
codes.description: A dependency is unavailable; nothing was decided or changed (MD-8).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The request path is not in its one canonical spelling (TN-113).

codes.title: Payload Too Large
codes.description: The request body exceeds the limit (R-5).

codes.title: Method Not Allowed
codes.description: The method is not served on this path.

codes.title: Too Many Requests
codes.description: A rate limit was reached; the RateLimit and Retry-After headers say when to retry (TN-127).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A mutating request carries no Idempotency-Key (TN-126).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The Idempotency-Key is empty, longer than 255 characters or not visible ASCII (TN-126).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The Idempotency-Key of a write is its AIS nonce, unpadded base64url (TN-126).

codes.title: Idempotency-Key reused with another request
codes.description: The Idempotency-Key already ran another request (TN-126, TI-8).

codes.title: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running
codes.description: The first request under the Idempotency-Key is still running (TN-126).

codes.title: Precondition Required
codes.description: An update must carry If-Match with the resource's ETag (OP-65).

codes.title: Precondition Failed
codes.description: If-Match does not name the resource's current ETag (OP-65).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The filter is outside the SCIM subset: eq, ne, co, sw, pr, and, or, parentheses (TN-112).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The filter names an attribute the endpoint does not filter on; it is never ignored (TN-112).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The filter exceeds its size, depth or term limits (CR-10).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The cursor was not issued by this list (OP-65).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: page[size] must be an integer from 1 to 100 (§13.7.4).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: A query parameter the endpoint does not take, or one given twice.

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The body is not a JSON Merge Patch the resource takes (RFC 7396).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The request is malformed.

codes.title: Unauthorized
codes.description: No usable read token: missing, bearer, malformed, expired, revoked or not holder-bound (TN-27, TN-130).

codes.title: Unauthorized
codes.description: The token's audience is another management surface (TN-119).

codes.title: Unauthorized
codes.description: Management read tokens live at most 60 minutes (OP-151 m.3 (c)).

codes.title: Forbidden
codes.description: The token lacks the route's scope (TN-113).

codes.title: Unauthorized
codes.description: A write carries the caller's AIS; no token writes (TN-110, TN-130).

codes.title: Unauthorized
codes.description: The AIS is not a well-formed, signed actor intent statement (PI-7).

codes.title: Forbidden
codes.description: The AIS does not verify with a live Instance key of this surface's domain, or names another domain or mode (PI-7, TN-119).

codes.title: Forbidden
codes.description: The Exercise the write compiled to was decided and not allowed; nothing changed (TN-110).

codes.title: Bad Request
codes.description: The Exercise the write compiled to was refused before a decision; nothing changed (TN-110).
